suggestions.uses_simple_repetition: Remember to use REPETITION to do something multiple times, instead of many equal blocks!
suggestions.uses_conditional_alternative: Does your program work only sometimes? You could use conditional alternatives to check for all possible scenarios.
suggestions.uses_conditional_repetition: You can use conditional repetition if you need to repeat something until the condition is met.
suggestions.main_too_long: Main program is too long and hard to read. Try divinding it into simpler pieces of work using procedures.
suggestions.too_long: This procedure is too long and hard to read. Try divinding it into simpler pieces of work using procedures.
suggestions.do_something: This procedure is empty and thus does nothing. Add blocks to it so it can work.
suggestions.name_was_changed: You can name this procedure. A good idea for any procedure's name is to think: What does it do?
suggestions.is_used: This procedure is not being used by any part of the program. Click on the hand to create a functional command to use.
suggestions.is_used_from_main: This procedure is being used by another one, but that one is not being called by the main program. Check for errors to make it work.
suggestions.does_not_use_recursion: Be Careful! This procedure is trying to call itself! Try to tackle this challenge in a different way.
suggestions.does_not_nest_control_structures: This block could be inside a procedure which's name describes what it does.

control_group.uses_simple_repetition: You should use simple repetition for the repeating parts of your program.
control_group.uses_conditional_alternative: You should use conditional alternative to consider all possible scenarios.
control_group.uses_conditional_repetition: You should use conditional repetition to consider all scenarios.
control_group.main_too_long: The main program should be subdivided into simpler pieces of work using procedures.
control_group.too_long: Your procedures should not be long, they should also be subdivided into simpler pieces of work (procedures).
control_group.do_something: You should not have empty procedures with no blocks.
control_group.name_was_changed: You should choose a good name for each one of your procedures.
control_group.does_not_nest_control_structures: You should also divide your repetitions and alternatives into simpler pieces of work using procedures.
